jobs.name: KelpCanopy
jobs.prompt: Stylized low-poly game asset, flat-shaded facets, bold clean colors, slightly realistic proportions, in the style of a cozy underwater adventure game: a wide floating canopy of giant kelp at the sea's surface, one broad flat mat: dozens of long golden-green leafy kelp blades and round olive gas bladders spreading out flat in every direction, with a few thick stalks and blades hanging down from its underside. Golden olive and kelp green. Chunky faceted. A single object, flat and wide, no water, no text.
